Subcommand order:
mcs order
order command:
mcs order {player count} {bot type} {carry service level} {duration}
Carry service level: 1~5
Duration: integer, in hours
Example: mcs order 4 0 5 24
This represents ordering a 4-player carry service with common player type, carry service level 5, and 24-hour duration. You will be charged for 4 players' 24-hour service in Rubles

Subcommand ticket:
mcs ticket
Ticket command:
mcs ticket {percentage}
percentage: 1~100%
Example: mcs ticket 80
This means taking a ticket to remove 80% of the price increase penalty; after paying the fine, 80% of the price increase penalty will be removed
